image_description: A group of people, mostly young women and girls, are dancing around a tall wooden maypole in a grassy park setting. The pole is decorated with long, colorful ribbons (red, blue, yellow, white) that the dancers are holding and weaving. The top of the pole features a decorative wreath or floral arrangement. Trees and houses are visible in the background under a bright sky.
